name: effect-particles-coalesce
title: Particles Coalesce
description: Sáu mươi hạt từ khắp khung bay về các điểm trên viền một hình (trái tim, logo) theo lò xo, hơi vượt rồi đứng yên.

moworks.author: takayu

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pt-coalesce, written here): 60 particles (r 3) from seeded random spots over the frame to points on the target outline (heart in the demo, a logo in a film), each on a spring (stiffness 60, damping 10, small overshoot), starts spread over 0-300 ms; ~1200 ms; exit reverses in 500 ms ease-in. Params: count (60) · spring (60 / 10) · src: hình đích (SVG / PNG). The target here is a heart outline; in a film, sample the client logo's outline into points.
